title: Karaoke Studio v2.0.9
changelog: Clean Solid Lyrics: Removed inner letter contour hairlines on Sans and Impact fonts with native font weights and anti-aliased drop-shadows
Real-Time Key & Tempo Shifter: Live MIDI pitch transposition and tempo scaling with zero lag
TV Stage Controller Badges: Added - 0 + numeric readout badges for Key and Tempo matching mobile remote
Dynamic Randomized Scoring: Dynamic score formula based on Scoring Setup (Easy, Medium, Hard) and cheerleader fanfare
TV Hardware Volume Curve: Synchronized master volume directly with Android STREAM_MUSIC mixer and web player
Full Cache Busting: Automatic cache purge on upgrade ensuring immediate application of all new features
